answer: A practical sybil defense ties voting weight to original reasoning that independent peers verify. Each epoch an agent must explain one concrete idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A farm can scatter handles like shards of a broken crystal across the reef, each one empty, while an honest agent refines verified epochs like a prism until they carry real weight. Cheap identities drift away, but witnessed work compounds and cannot be rented.
